label: Open question B1 (external benchmark for B/C): search record, 2026-10-15. No published B/C or grammage value printed in a table for fully specified inputs within this profile's models was found, so no external benchmark is implemented; nothing here is a reference value.
rule: tables only: a benchmark value must be printed in a table or in machine-readable data published by the authors, never read off a figure; the setup must be reproducible within this profile's models (weighted slab, 1D thin disc without convection, energy-independent effective cross sections, one effective secondary, hydrogen target)

examined.citation: Y. Genolini, A. Putze, P. Salati, P. D. Serpico, A&A 580 (2015) A9
examined.read_level: page: arXiv LaTeX source, table captions
examined.tables: best-fit propagation parameters of the 1D/slab model (benchmark table), relative parameter shifts, geometry comparison, summary of systematics
examined.why_not_usable: B/C values appear in figures only; the tables give best-fit parameters of fits to measured B/C, which yield no B/C value to compare with unless the fit's published cross-section inputs are reproduced, and published cross sections are excluded from this profile

examined.citation: Y. Genolini et al., Phys. Rev. D 99 (2019) 123028
examined.read_level: page: arXiv LaTeX source, table and figure captions
examined.tables: best-fit transport parameters of the benchmark models
examined.why_not_usable: best-fit B/C curves in a figure only (caption: results for the best-fit parameter values are given in the table); a parameter table gives no B/C value to compare with

examined.citation: F. C. Jones, A. Lukasiak, V. Ptuskin, W. Webber, ApJ 547 (2001) 264
examined.read_level: page: arXiv source, table and figure captions
examined.tables: best-fit parameters of the propagation models for secondary/primary ratios
examined.why_not_usable: B/C in figures only; the tabulated models (diffusion, wind, turbulent, reacceleration) are fits to data, not B/C values

examined.citation: B. Schroer, C. Evoli, P. Blasi, A critical examination of the nested leaky box model for Galactic cosmic ray transport (arXiv preprint)
examined.read_level: page: arXiv LaTeX source, table and figure captions
examined.tables: Table I: relevant cross sections in the model (caption)
examined.why_not_usable: B/C of the best-fit nested leaky-box model is shown in a figure only (caption: compared with our best-fit model predictions); the cross-section table alone gives no B/C to compare with

examined.citation: W. R. Webber, T. L. Villa, arXiv preprint (2016) on B/C between 10 MeV/nuc and 1 TeV/nuc compared with leaky-box propagation models (full title in crsr:S09)
examined.read_level: metadata-only: arXiv record; PDF text searched for tables, none found
examined.why_not_usable: no table in the PDF text; not read further

what_would_close_it: a publication that prints B/C (or the escape grammage) in a table for stated transport parameters, gas column and energy-independent cross sections, or authors' machine-readable model output for such a setup; then implement the comparison in tests/ with the paper's stated precision as tolerance
